newsitem.title: FINLAND: SILJA LINE TO UP VAASA-UUMAJA CAPACITY.
newsitem.headline: SILJA LINE TO UP VAASA-UUMAJA CAPACITY.

text.p: Finnish ferry operator Silja Line, part of Silja Oy Ab, said on Wednesday it would increase its capacity on the Vaasa-Uumaja route by replacing the Fennia ferry with the bigger Wasa Express.
"Car ferry Wasa Express will start on the Vaasa-Uumaja route on May 8 (1997)," Silja Line said in a statement.
The Wasa Express, now operating in the Channel, can carry 1,754 passengers, Silja said. The Fennia's capacity is 1,200 passengers.
The Wasa Queen, which can carry 1,599 passengers and was on the Vaasa-Uumaja route last summer, will now continue to serve the Helsinki-Tallinn route, a Silja spokeswoman said.
The Fennia will be moved to the Pietarsaari-Skelleftea route, she said.
Silja said earlier this year it would restructure its U.K. operations.
